caption: This shoyu ramen features a golden-brown, glossy broth with thin noodles and shredded cabbage. Served in a white ceramic bowl with a subtly textured rim, it rests on a light wood grain table with soft shadows near the edge.

segments_info.text: Light wood grain table surface with subtle vertical lines and soft shadows near the bowl's edge.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and clear, with thin noodles and shredded cabbage floating on its surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
